device.description: 16-bit 500 kSPS 4-channel unipolar SAR ADC with mux breakout, SPI/DSP serial interface, TAG bits and daisy chain
device.note: ads8332.pdf (SBAS363E, ADS8331/ADS8332) p.4-5 pin configuration and functions, p.6 recommended operating conditions (VBD 1.65 V to VA + 0.2 V), p.7-10 electrical characteristics (tCONV 18 CCLK, straight binary), p.11-12 timing (internal CCLK 10.5 MHz min at VA = 2.7 V), p.23-25 channel select modes, conversion start, EOC/INT, p.26-27 power-down modes, p.29 digital interface (CPOL = 1, CPHA = 0), p.30 Table 4 commands, p.31 Table 5 CFR, p.32 data format (Table 6), TAG, p.35-36 reset

registers.name: CFR
registers.note: p.31 Table 5: configuration register, default FFFh (POR, software reset, RESET pin, command 1111b); no address (CMR commands 1100b/1110b/1111b). D11 channel select mode, D10 CCLK source, D9 trigger, D8 auto-trigger rate, D7 EOC/INT polarity, D6 EOC/INT function, D5 pin 10 output / CDI, D4 auto-NAP, D3 nap, D2 deep power-down, D1 TAG, D0 software reset

registers.name: CHSEL
registers.note: internal: the channel chosen by the CMR select-channel commands (Table 4); its power-on value is not documented

commands.name: Select analog input channel 0
commands.note: p.30 Table 4: 4-bit command, takes effect on the 4th SCLK falling edge; also wakes from auto-NAP

commands.name: Wake up
commands.note: p.31 Table 5: the wake-up command sets CFR D3 and D2 to 1

commands.name: Read CFR
commands.note: p.30-31: the read-back is the four MSBs of the previous result then the 12-bit CFR

commands.name: Write CFR (D0 = 0: software reset)
commands.note: p.31 Table 5 D0: 0 = system reset, returns to 1 automatically (CFR to FFFh)

commands.name: Write CFR
commands.note: p.31: 4-bit command plus 12 bits of CFR data, effective at the 16th SCLK falling edge

commands.name: Default mode (load CFR with default value)
commands.note: p.30-31: CFR loaded with FFFh at the 4th falling edge

pages: p.4-5 (pin configuration, pin functions for each device), p.6 (ROC), p.7-10 (electrical characteristics: tCONV 18 CCLK, straight binary, VIH/VIL), p.11 (timing VA = 2.7 V: CCLK 10.5-12.2 MHz internal, tD2/tD3 35 ns, tD4 15 ns), p.12 (timing VA = 5 V, Figure 1), p.23-25 (channel select, conversion start, Table 1, EOC/INT), p.26-27 (power-down, Table 2), p.29 (digital interface, CPOL = 1 CPHA = 0), p.30 (Table 4), p.31 (Table 5), p.32 (Table 6, TAG), p.35-36 (reset)
notModeled: analog input, mux breakout (MUXOUT/ADCIN) and external reference: every conversion returns the 0 V code 0000h

conversion time is 18 CCLK at the 10.5 MHz minimum internal clock at VA = 2.7 V (1714.3 ns); CCLK = SCLK/2 (CFR D10 = 0), the 21/42-CCLK auto-trigger cycle (D9 = 0, D8) and the minimum CONVST spacing (21 CCLK) are not timed; with auto trigger the model converts back to back
auto channel select (CFR D11 = 1, the power-on default) sequencing from the last channel up to channel 3: the channel only changes with the select-channel commands
quiet zone around end of sampling and the pipelined result (reading before end of conversion gives the previous result): the model always outputs the constant 0 V code
SDO outputs all 1s during the first cycle after power-on, software or external reset (the model outputs the normal frame)
daisy-chain mode (CFR D5 = 0: EOC/INT/CDI becomes the chain data input, 16/24-SCLK pass-through); with D5 = 0 the pin is left inactive
power-down modes: deep power-down (D2), nap (D3), auto-NAP (D4) and their wake-up times; CFR bits are stored only, Wake up sets D3/D2
the 4-bit CMR is not readable; the CFR read-back reply starts after the 4 command bits (the 4 result MSBs before it are the frame's normal output)
TAG bits (CFR D1 = 1): the three channel bits follow the LSB; the channel shown is CHSEL.CH
2 us minimum after a reset before the next frame; RESET low minimum 25 ns
vcc: VBD recommended max is VA + 0.2 V (5.7 V at VA = 5.5 V)
timing values are the VA = 2.7 V, VBD = 1.65 V table (tD3 35 ns, tD2 35 ns, tD4 15 ns); 20 / 20 / 10 ns at VA = VBD = 5 V
channel select commands 0100b-0111b are reserved on the ADS8331 (ignored by the model)
variants: ADS8331 (4 channels, pins IN4-IN7 NC, channel commands 4-7 reserved) and ADS8332 (8 channels) share ads8332.pdf; own spec each. ADS8329/ADS8330 are the 1-/2-channel versions; ADS7279/ADS7280 the 14-bit relatives.
